The parent is re-rendering. By default, React re-renders all children whenever the parent re-renders, regardless of whether the props changed. Three quick checks: **Is the parent re-rendering too often?** Check if state in the parent is being set on every render (like inside `useEffect` with no dependency array, or state that triggers itself). Use React DevTools Profiler to see what's causing the parent to re-render. **Are you passing new objects or functions?** Even if the values are the same, if you create them fresh each render — like `` or `onClick={() => handleClick()}` — the child sees new props and re-renders. Move them outside the render or memoize them with `useMemo` or `useCallback`. **Does the child need `React.memo`?** If the parent re-renders but the props don't actually change, wrap the child in `React.memo` to skip the re-render: ```javascript const Child = React.memo(({ prop }) =>
{prop}
); ``` If you share the component code, I can pinpoint which one it is.
